title: Why is the Sky Blue?
subtitle: A colorful adventure for curious kids

chapters.title: Sunlight and Our Sky
chapters.kicker: The colorful mystery above our heads

captions.text: Have you ever wondered why our sky is blue?
The sun sends us light, but is it really white?
Sunlight actually has all colors of the rainbow!
So why doesn't our sky look rainbow colored?

chapters.title: Bouncing Blue Light
chapters.kicker: The secret of blue sky revealed

captions.text: When sunlight hits our atmosphere, something amazing happens!
Tiny air molecules scatter the sunlight like bouncing balls
Blue light bounces around the most in all directions!
Other colors mostly pass straight through
So we see blue light coming from everywhere in the sky!
That's why our daytime sky is blue!
